name: Java
needs: JDK 21 (uses the preview FFM API) or JDK 22 and newer and nasm and ld (Linux x86-64) or as and ld (Linux ARM64)
notes: Uses the standard Foreign Function & Memory API, so there is no JNI and no extra library. On JDK 21 it is a preview feature, so `run.sh` compiles with `--enable-preview`; on JDK 22+ it is final and `run.sh` compiles normally.
`read` returns at most 4096 frames per call.
files: demo: decodes the test files and prints checksums
compiles and runs the demo (picks the right flags for your JDK)
